metadata.value: Support for DAVIS event cameras; Event-only, Event-Image (monocular), Event-Image-Inertial (monocular), Event-Inertial (monocular) modes; automatic dataset loader; sensor configuration object; mixed key point tracking with AKAZE and ORB features
metadata.normalized_value: Support for DAVIS event cameras; Event-only, Event-Image (monocular), Event-Image-Inertial (monocular), Event-Inertial (monocular) modes; automatic dataset loader; sensor configuration object; mixed key point tracking with AKAZE and ORB features
metadata.evidence:
**Contributions**:

- Support for DAVIS event cameras
- Added these modes to the original algorithm: Event-only, Event-Image (monocular), Event-Image-Inertial (monocular), Event-Inertial (monocular)
- Dataset loader can automatically load different datasets and configuration parameters
- Introducing sensor configuration object
- Mixed key point tracking (in addition to ORB features, the proposed algorithm can use both the AKAZE and ORB features for image-based SLAM)
metadata.reason: Summarizes the concrete contributions and capabilities of the artifact.

metadata.value: The app is not stable; backend optimizer throws unhandled exceptions on small event-based images; possible race conditions and deadlocks due to parallel threads
metadata.normalized_value: The app is not stable; backend optimizer throws unhandled exceptions on small event-based images; possible race conditions and deadlocks due to parallel threads
metadata.evidence:
- Generally, __this app is not stable__. There are some issues in the ORB-SLAM3 algorithm itself. The original algorithm is designed for larger images of datasets like `EuRoC`. If you try to run it on small images of an event-based dataset (especially the hdr_boxes of The Public Event dataset) the backend (optimizer) throws unhandled exceptions. Such optimization exceptions might randomly happen for the EORB-SLAM algorithm.
- For performance, most main components of this algorithm are executed in parallel threads. Unexpected race conditions and deadlocks are other issues of this algorithm.
metadata.reason: Documents known stability issues and limitations important for reuse decisions.
